title: BPP equals P when P equals NP
statement: If $\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{NP}$, then for every language $L$ of bit strings, $L$ belongs to BPP relative to the polynomial-time verifier model if and only if $L \in \mathrm{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
